ticker.name: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY INC

business_summary: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. provides smartphone services and solutions in Japan. The company develops smartphone platform solutions and IoT-related solutions; and handles social games, apps, commissioned game development, and other commissioned development projects. It also offers computer education for individuals and businesses; real estate leasing and subleasing; IT school seminars for job seekers; public vocational and corporate training; skills education in the areas of IT, web, and generative AI; employment support; fan club management; capsule toys, character products, and novelty items; tanning machines; health and beauty equipment; and temporary staffing and paid employment placement agency services. In addition, the company engages in the planning, production, and performance of various events, such as concerts, plays, performances, lectures, and sports events; music production; management, sale, and licensing of intellectual property rights; infrastructure construction and civil engineering works; paving, scaffolding, earthwork, concrete, and demolition works; wedding venue and accommodation facility operation; and sale and management of leak detection equipment. Further, it is involved in the manufacture, import, repair, maintenance, sale of measuring instruments for maintenance and inspection of social infrastructure, such as telecommunications, water supply, and electricity; sale, rental, and maintenance of LED lighting; applications for outdoor advertising; sign construction; management and administration of stores; development, sale, and wholesale of cosmetics and other products; wedding attire, wedding planning, restaurant, auberge glamping, and banquet/production services; and gold trading activities. The company was formerly known as Acrodea, Inc. and changed its name to THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. in January 2022. THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
business_summary_ko: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc.는 일본에서 스마트폰 서비스 및 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 스마트폰 플랫폼 솔루션과 IoT 관련 솔루션을 개발합니다. 소셜 게임, 앱, 게임 위탁 개발, 기타 위탁 개발 프로젝트를 처리합니다. 또한 개인과 기업을 위한 컴퓨터 교육도 제공합니다. 부동산 임대 및 전대; 구직자를 위한 IT 학교 세미나; 공공 직업 및 기업 훈련; IT, 웹, 제너레이티브 AI 분야의 기술 교육; 취업지원; 팬클럽 운영; 캡슐 토이, 캐릭터 상품, 노벨티 아이템; 태닝 기계; 건강 및 미용 장비; 임시 직원 채용 및 유급 취업 알선 기관 서비스. 또한 콘서트, 연극, 공연, 강연, 스포츠 경기 등 각종 행사의 기획, 제작, 공연 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 음악 제작; 지적 재산권의 관리, 판매 및 라이센스; 기반시설 건설 및 토목공사; 포장, 비계, 토공사, 콘크리트 및 철거 작업; 결혼식장 및 숙박 시설 운영; 누출 감지 장비의 판매 및 관리. 푸르트
